layout.hero: SOURCE_FACT: Preserve the dark desk system, existing typography and restrained gold accents. Make one suggested PAPER ticket the primary task: index, expiry, strike, CE/PE BUY, lifecycle status, entry/limit, SL, target and 1 lot paper. Place the underlying chart beside or immediately below it, with confidence in the right rail. Any interaction must say PAPER and must not route live orders.
deprioritize: Remove sentiment/CAS panels from above the ticket.
Move strategy names, indicators and technical diagnostics into optional detail.
Place today's paper book below the ticket/chart workspace.
Avoid competing signal cards, promotional performance claims and purple AI styling.
layout.empty_state: Show exactly WAITING FOR NEXT SIGNAL when no eligible suggested ticket or active paper trade exists. Leave the signal window otherwise empty; remove stale ticket values, confidence and trade overlays. A retained background chart must remain labeled PAPER / MOCK as applicable.

chart.series: MT5-like underlying-index price path using timestamped candles or a line, with a readable price axis, crosshair and Asia/Kolkata timestamps. Use separate styling for historical price and any hypothetical annotations; do not draw a predicted continuation.
markers: CE BUY or PE BUY at signal time; distinguish suggestion from simulated fill.
Underlying reference at signal or simulated entry time.
Underlying entry/limit, stop and target lines only when those levels are defined in underlying-price units.
Simulated exit markers labeled STOP LOSS HIT or TARGET HIT when supported by the paper ledger.
chart.honesty: SOURCE_FACT: PAPER only, no live orders. Label generated paths MOCK prominently. Option-premium entry/SL/target values must not be plotted against the spot-price axis; show them in the ticket or a separate premium pane. Label data source, timestamp and freshness. No invented fill markers.

confidence_rail.hero_bullets: Show 'Signal confidence: N% — PAPER', followed by up to three plain-language reasons supported by available inputs, such as 'Price remains inside the entry zone' or 'Quote is recent'. Label simulated reasons MOCK. Add 'Model score, not a win probability'. If the score is unavailable or stale, show unavailable rather than a fabricated percentage.
confidence_rail.info_detail: The (i) opens 'HYPOTHESIS / PAPER — technical and liquidity detail'. Separate SOURCE_FACT inputs and timestamps from VALIDATION checks and HYPOTHESIS interpretation. Include score definition/version, freshness, spread/depth availability, fill/slippage assumptions and limitations. Strategy/indicator diagnostics belong here, not in the hero.

columns: Index / expiry / strike / CE or PE
Paper outcome: success / loss / flat / open / no entry
Quantity — 1 lot PAPER, with contract units
summary: Today's closed paper successes, losses and flats; open and unfilled signals listed separately.
Cumulative realized premium points — PAPER; MOCK when generated data contributes. State period and gross/net basis.
Paper win% = profitable closed paper trades / all closed paper trades, including flats; exclude open and unfilled tickets. Show numerator, denominator and N/A for zero closed trades.
Historical paper win% is separate from confidence and is not a forecast.
ledger_fields_for_nightly: index, instrument_id, expiry, strike, option_type, side

accepted: Single-ticket hierarchy using SignalCard, ConfidenceBox and TodaysBook.
Dark desk aesthetic with restrained gold.
Underlying chart, explainable confidence rail and auditable paper book.
Consistent customer-facing status vocabulary with PAPER/MOCK disclosures.
rejected: Sentiment/CAS clutter above the suggested ticket.
Customer-facing STRAT names or indicator soup.
Confidence presented as future win rate.
Live-order controls, unlabeled mock data or simulated fills presented as executions.
Option-premium levels drawn directly on an underlying-price axis.
risks: HYPOTHESIS: status_map is a conservative display proposal, not verified backend semantics. VALIDATION must confirm WATCH versus EARLY and whether CONFIRMED means entry-eligible or actually simulated-filled; NEW ENTRY must not imply a fill without one.
LOST is ambiguous. Default INVALIDATED blocks entry but must not create a realized loss. Require a reason code; verified stop exits map to STOP LOSS HIT.
EXPIRED maps to INVALIDATED only for an unfilled signal. An already-filled position requires a recorded exit and outcome, not silent invalidation.

TRADE COMPLETED is derived from reconciled paper closure when no more specific terminal label applies. Preserve stop/target outcomes in the book. WAITING FOR NEXT SIGNAL is derived from absence of an eligible ticket or active trade, not a forced one-to-one legacy mapping.
VALIDATION: missing, stale or failed data must block NEW ENTRY and expose the data issue; the empty-state message must not conceal a feed failure.
Premium points, spot points and quantity-weighted P&L are different measures. Define units before implementing summaries.
Paper fills, spread and slippage assumptions can materially inflate apparent performance; show sample size and MOCK provenance.
impl_order: Validate lifecycle semantics, units, data provenance and paper-fill rules; add status-transition tests.
Build the single-ticket layout and exact empty state; remove above-ticket clutter.
Implement lightweight-charts with unit-safe overlays and PAPER/MOCK labels.
Add confidence reasons, unavailable/stale handling and layered information detail.
Implement ledger-backed paper book and denominator-safe summaries.
Test invalidation, expiry after fill, ambiguous LOST, feed failure, terminal-to-empty transitions and nightly reconciliation; verify no live-order path.
